snippet.title: HOTEL BARCELONA Launch Trailer and exclusive SWERY and SUDA interview  - PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct
snippet.description:
We sat down with SWERY and SUDA51 to find out the deepest darkest secrets of HOTEL BARCELONA, the brand new action roguelike from 
White Owls Inc. and CULT Games. Check out what they had to say... if you dare!

HOTEL BARCELONA is out not on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2286600/HOTEL_BARCELONA/

https://www.pcgamer.com
